ColorOS 11 requires signature-level INTERNAL_DELETE_CACHE_FILES (UID 1000). Shell UID 2000 is silently ignored by the OS. Standard Clean remains available.

On this Android 11 / ColorOS 11 firmware, private app cache deletion is gated behind android.permission.INTERNAL_DELETE_CACHE_FILES (UID 1000 / system only).

Even with Shizuku (UID 2000 shell), calls are silently ignored by the OS.

You can still use Standard Clean to clear all accessible shared-storage cache.

Diagnostic probe to passively inspect ColorOS 11 Settings screens for cache controls without modifying data or clearing cache.

Passive diagnostic only. Enable the probe in Accessibility Settings, then tap OPEN INSTAGRAM APP INFO and navigate to Storage Usage without tapping Clear Cache. Inspect logcat under tag RMX_A11Y_PROBE.
Experimental pilot to test automated navigation and private cache cleaning for Instagram only. Operates under strict dual-confirmation safeguards and never touches app data.

This will test automated clearing of Instagram's private cache via ColorOS Settings.

Flow:
1. Opens Instagram's App info screen.
2. Navigates to Storage usage.
3. Measures displayed cache size.
4. Shows a final confirmation dialog before clearing.

Personal data, chats, logins, and photos will remain untouched.
